audit.whatIsWrong: Content 'early' field and wants.foe[0] call Vel'Koz's Q 'Void Rift' — Void Rift is actually his W (per enemyAbilities: Q=Plasma Fission, W=Void Rift). Also missingInteractions flags that his true damage (P Organic Deconstruction, R Life Form Disintegration Ray) bypasses raw armour/MR, which is not mentioned anywhere in the page. Separately, full-layer phases[N].side disagrees with content win[N] on all 7 rows (rows 0/1/6 say 'Vel'Koz'/'Skill' where win[] already says Janna; rows 2-5 say 'Vel'Koz'/'Skill' inconsistently with win[]='Vel'Koz', and their why-text still argues Janna's favor).
audit.why: Kit confirms Q=Plasma Fission (7s CD, splits on hit/reactivation), W=Void Rift (1.5s CD, double-burst), E=Tectonic Disruption (knockup), P/R both trueDamage. Chart rows 2-5 (win[]='Vel'Koz') had full-layer why text praising Janna's shields/chip, contradicting the enemy-favored side.
audit.corrected: Swap 'Void Rift' to 'Plasma Fission' where it names the Q ability. Set phases[0].side, phases[1].side, phases[6].side to Janna (matching win[]; why text already correct). Set phases[2-5].side to Vel'Koz (matching win[]) and rewrite their why text to state the Vel'Koz-favoring interaction. Add a note on resistance-bypass since no safe slot exists to state it without breaking length band.
